ranking.note: Lowered: speculative draft policy for an unratified soft fork, vendoring unmerged libsecp work; no downstream demand on mempool policy yet.

inconsistencies: #36182 and #36317 both alter fee-estimator inputs (sparse-mempool fallback vs. mined-coverage weights); review #36182 first since it changes the estimator's error/fallback contract that #36317's coverage calculation builds on.

#35286 (testsubmitpackage) reports package validation results; #36328 changes which result code trimmed package transactions receive (TX_RECONSIDERABLE vs TX_MEMPOOL_POLICY). #36328 should be reviewed first so the new RPC surfaces the settled semantics.

#36214 (cluster limits during reorgs) and #35026 (lockpoint recalculation in removeForReorg) touch the same reorg resurrection path; #35026 is the behavioural fix and should lead, with #36214 read as complementary coverage.
#36122 includes a full mempool-policy component but the author states it is not intended for merge; its mempool value is contingent on a consensus decision made outside this category.
result.notes: The list splits cleanly: three acceptance/estimation correctness bugs with concrete downstream impact (P2), a middle band of useful-but-deferrable policy/RPC/test work including cluster-mempool coverage (P3), and three marginal items (P4). No PR here rises to P1: none is a live DoS or pinning vector, and none blocks several other PRs.
